title: The Gender Code: Gendering the Global Governance of Artificial Intelligence
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement. It performs a qualitative analysis of AI governance documents. Religion/faith is mentioned only as a societal factor influencing AI governance.
findings: The paper mentions that 'religious leaders' are among the stakeholders in the conversation about AI harms. It also identifies 'rising right-wing, conservative, populist, and religious forces' as drivers of gender backlash, which may create resistance to promoting gender diversity and equality in AI governance in certain regions.
